OurPlatform.title: One Ecosystem
OurPlatform.description: AgroTrust brings together the key participants in global commodity trade into one structured ecosystem. Through a controlled framework, buyers, producers, capital partners, and service providers can operate with more transparency, security, and efficiency across every stage of the transaction.

1.title: Buyer due diligence & structuring
1.description: AgroTrust begins by validating parties involved and defining the structure of the transaction. This includes assessing counterparties, aligning deal terms, and creating a framework that reduces uncertainty before execution begins.

2.title: Collateral & financing
2.description: Once the deal is structured, the platform supports the financial layer of the transaction through collateral organization and funding coordination. This helps ensure that capital is deployed within a secure framework that protects all parties involved.

3.title: Shipment & escrow
3.description: AgroTrust helps coordinate the operational and financial controls tied to execution, including shipment oversight and escrow mechanisms. This adds a layer of protection and transparency as goods and payments move through the process.

4.title: Distribution & final execution
4.description: The final stage focuses on completing the transaction efficiently and ensuring all participants remain aligned through delivery and distribution. The result is a more seamless execution process with clearer accountability from start to finish.

1.title: 1. Buyer Due Diligence
1.description: Buyers are introduced and vetted, ensuring qualified demand enters the platform.

2.title: 2. Structuring & Participant Alignment
2.lead: AgroTrust structures the transaction, aligning all parties:

3.title: 3. Pre-Shipment Collateralization
3.description: The commodity is delivered to a regulated general deposit warehouse and secured through a pledge bond, creating a collateral-backed financing structure.

4.title: 4. Financing Deployment
4.description: Capital is deployed, typically up to 70-80% of the transaction value, within a secured framework backed by the underlying asset.

5.title: 5. Shipment Under Control
5.description: The cargo is shipped under a controlled structure, ensuring full control of the goods throughout transit until payment is received.

6.title: 6. Escrow-Based Payment
6.description: The buyer remits payment exclusively into a designated escrow account, eliminating payment risk.

7.title: 7. Automated Waterfall Distribution
7.description: Funds are distributed automatically through a predefined waterfall including all participants.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: AgroTrust, LLC ("AgroTrust," "we," "us"), operates a structured trade finance platform connecting investors, producers, buyers and service providers in agricultural commodity trade. This policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your choices.

information.title: 1. Information we collect
items: Contact details you give us: name, company, email address, phone or WhatsApp number, and the content of your inquiry.
Business and transaction information needed to evaluate or operate a trade, including know-your-customer (KYC) and anti-money-laundering (AML) documentation.
Technical data collected automatically when you visit our website, such as IP address, browser type and pages viewed.

use.title: 2. How we use information
items: To respond to inquiries and provide our services.
To evaluate, document, execute and settle transactions on our platform.
To send service messages by email, phone or text message (SMS), including reminders, confirmations and follow-ups, where you have agreed to receive them.
To meet legal, regulatory, compliance and security obligations.

sms.title: 3. Text messaging (SMS) and mobile information
items: If you agree to receive text messages from AgroTrust, we use your mobile number only to send you the messages you agreed to. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out at any time, or HELP for help. See our SMS Terms.

No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. All the categories of sharing described in this policy exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.

sharing.title: 4. How we share information
sharing.intro: We do not sell personal information. We share it only:
items: With service providers who help us operate the platform (for example escrow agents, logistics providers, hosting and messaging providers), under confidentiality obligations and only as needed to provide the service.
With counterparties to a transaction you take part in, to the extent required to execute it.
When required by law, regulation, court order, or to protect our rights and the security of the platform.

retention.title: 5. Data retention and security
retention.content: We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law, and we protect it with administrative, technical and physical safeguards appropriate to its sensitivity.

choices.title: 6. Your choices and rights
choices.content: You may ask to access, correct or delete your personal information, or withdraw consent to messages, by contacting us below. You can opt out of text messages at any time by replying STOP.

changes.title: 7. Changes
changes.content: We may update this policy. The "Last updated" date shows the latest version.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.content: AgroTrust, LLC · 8 The Green, Suite D, Dover, DE 19901, USA · admin@agrotrust.com.ve · +1 954 353 6494 (TEXT & WHATSAPP)

program.title: 1. Program description.
program.content: The AgroTrust messaging program sends service text messages to clients, partners, lenders, producers and service providers who have agreed to receive them. Messages include meeting and deadline reminders, document and signature requests, transaction status updates, and follow-ups. Every message begins: "This text is being sent by AgroTrust's Agent." We do not send marketing messages through this program.

optIn.title: 2. How you opt in.
optIn.content: You agree to receive messages by checking the SMS consent box on our website contact form, or by giving your consent in writing (for example by email) or verbally to an AgroTrust representative, who records it. Consent is not a condition of any purchase or service.

frequency.title: 3. Message frequency.
frequency.content: Message frequency varies based on your activity with AgroTrust.

costs.title: 4. Costs.
costs.content: Message and data rates may apply, according to your mobile plan.

optingOut.title: 5. Opting out.
optingOut.content: Reply STOP to any message to stop receiving texts. You will receive one final message confirming you have been unsubscribed. To rejoin, reply START or contact us.

help.title: 6. Help.
help.content: Reply HELP to any message, or contact us at admin@agrotrust.com.ve or +1 954 353 6494 (TEXT & WHATSAPP)

carriers.title: 7. Carriers.
carriers.content: Mobile carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

privacy.title: 8. Privacy.
privacy.content: Your mobile number and consent are handled under our Privacy Policy. No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.
